queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux AS src,
         AVG(CASE WHEN s.boxz IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz <> 0 AND s.boxy IS NOT NULL THEN s.boxy * 1.0 / s.boxz END) AS ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM g)
SELECT AVG(g.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       SUM(g.cnt) AS total_count,
       AVG(g.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess
FROM g, a
WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux AS src,
         AVG(CASE WHEN s.boxz = 0 THEN NULL ELSE s.boxy * 1.0 / s.boxz END) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM g
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       SUM(g.cnt) AS total_count,
       AVG(g.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess
FROM g, a
WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux AS src,
         SUM(s.boxy) * 1.0 / SUM(s.boxz) AS ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g
)
SELECT AVG(g.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       SUM(g.cnt) AS total_records,
       AVG(g.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess
FROM g, a
WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN p.fundflux IS NULL
        OR TRIM(p.fundflux) = ''
        OR LOWER(TRIM(p.fundflux)) IN ('n/a', 'na', 'unknown', 'none', 'null', 'tbd', '-', '?')
      THEN NULL
      ELSE p.fundflux
    END AS src,
    AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS r,
    COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY 1
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM g
)
SELECT
  AVG(g.r) AS avg_ratio,
  SUM(g.n) AS total_records,
  AVG(g.n - a.avg_n) AS avg_excess
FROM g, a
WHERE g.n > a.avg_n;
